scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,backend,frontend -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @planner/shared" "npm run dev -w @planner/backend" "npm run dev -w @planner/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @planner/backend && npm run build -w @planner/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
